blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — State-run Aurora Pacific Economic Zone and Freeport Authority (Apeco) is exploring a large-scale renewable energy project it hopes will attract more investors to its Casiguran site. On Wednesday, Apeco said in a statement it had tapped solar panel manufacturer Huge Energy Co. Ltd. for the project, which it envisions in three phases. READ: APECO bags P18-B in investment pledges Huge Energy is the Japanese unit of the Chinese firm Xiamen Huge Energy.
